new.n: Bogus Creek counterfeiters' den, Pepin Township (name origin)
new.pl: GNIS Bogus Creek (mouth), Pepin Township; the plowed fields along the stream are not placed
new.v: History marker only; nothing of value recorded
new.st: From 1848 settlers plowing along this stream turned up tools and bars of metal that had probably been used by a gang of counterfeiters, which gave the creek its name. Nothing of value is recorded; history marker only, look-only.
new.t: History marker only, look-only. No cache was ever claimed here.
src: History of Buffalo and Pepin Counties, Wisconsin (1919), vol. 2, p. 714 (Biles biography), HathiTrust
pinev: GNIS Bogus Creek mouth (44.45469, -92.21934); the finds were 'along this stream', place not given.
